sources: exercises.json: a cuff on the ankle, lean forward a little, kick back and slightly out, without arching the lower back
docs/research/grip.md: an ankle cuff, a free hand steadying on the column

lines.says: the hip opens from under the body until the thigh runs about in line with the trunk
the kicking knee goes from bent to about straight
the foot makes a real kick
a free hand steadies on the column through the rep
the trunk leans forward through the whole rep
the trunk holds its lean: the leg moves, not the back
the hips stay about where they are
the leg kicks back and slightly out, not straight back and not out to the side
at the kick the lower back stays flat, not arched
the cable runs from a low pulley to a cuff on the ankle
